items.definition:
the clearing of forests
Deforestation is a major cause of climate change.

time during which a machine or activity is not working or active
The server experienced unexpected downtime last night.

a rider or performer on horseback
The equestrian skillfully guided her horse over the jumps.

a wide, open area or extent
They gazed out at the vast expanse of the desert.

an additional piece of information printed at the bottom of a page
Please check the footnote for more details.

a set of gears with their casing, especially in a motor vehicle
The car needed a new gearbox.

A small, bearded creature in folklore, typically wearing a pointed hat and living in a garden.
The garden gnome stood proudly among the flowers.

The threat of being shot.
He was forced to hand over his wallet at gunpoint.

Emotional pain or grief.
Losing her pet caused her immense heartache.

The quality or character of a particular person or thing that distinguishes them from others.
The artist encouraged each student to express their individuality.

A deciduous tree with heart-shaped leaves and fragrant yellow flowers.
A beautiful linden tree stood in the center of the park.

A piece of rock or metal that has fallen to Earth from space as a meteor.
Scientists found a large meteorite in the desert.

A quantity by which a given number is to be multiplied; a factor that amplifies an effect.
In economics, the multiplier effect describes how an initial change in spending can lead to a larger change in national income.

beginner
As a newbie, I'm still learning how to use this software.

the state of being unknown or unclear
After years of obscurity, the artist finally gained recognition.

a precious gemstone
She wore a beautiful necklace with a shimmering opal pendant.

a medium-sized game bird
A partridge flew out from the bushes as we walked by.

a lively dance of Bohemian origin
The band played a lively polka, and everyone started dancing.

a mammal of the order Primates (e.g., monkeys, apes, humans)
Humans, monkeys, and apes are all types of primates.

a ranch or large estate, especially in the southwestern US or Mexico
The old rancho had been converted into a beautiful hotel.

the act of becoming aware of something; achievement
The sudden realisation of her mistake made her blush.

the process of improving something; elegance
The design underwent several refinements before it was finalized.

an act of improving the form, structure, or appearance of something
The old restaurant underwent a complete revamp.

a flat piece hinged vertically near the stern of a boat or aircraft for steering
The pilot adjusted the rudder to change the direction of the plane.

a person who works on a ship; a sailor
The old seaman had many stories about his voyages.

sleep
He fell into a deep slumber.

rigidity, lack of flexibility
He felt a stiffness in his neck after sleeping awkwardly.

a sudden downward movement
The hawk made a sudden swoop to catch its prey.

a loud cry of joy or excitement
They let out a whoop of delight.

a state of anxiety or nervous excitement.
He was in a state of agitation before the exam.

an object made by a human being, typically an item of cultural or historical interest.
The museum displayed ancient artefacts from Egypt.

a player positioned at one of the bases in baseball.
The first baseman caught the ball.

something that requires little or no thought.
Deciding to take the easy path was a no-brainer.

a sloping channel or slide for conveying things to a lower level.
The laundry went down the chute to the basement.

a thick mass of coagulated liquid, especially blood.
The doctor was concerned about the blood clot.

the friendly company or society of others.
She valued the companionship of her friends.

a fluid used to reduce heat
The car's engine overheated because it was low on coolant.

the period when a man and woman are developing a romantic relationship
Their courtship lasted for two years before they got married.

a person who is very interested in and enthusiastic about someone or something
She is a devotee of classical music.

a decline in economic activity
The company struggled during the recent economic downturn.

a player in cricket or baseball who fields the ball
The outfielder made an amazing catch.

the action of forging or producing a copy of a document, signature, banknote, or work of art
The painting was later discovered to be a forgery.

a trick or device intended to attract attention, publicity, or trade
The new product's main selling point was just a marketing gimmick.

A person, often a slave or captive, who fought to the death in an arena for public entertainment in ancient Rome.
The gladiator raised his sword, ready for the final blow.

Preliminary work; the basic preparation for something.
They laid the groundwork for the new project by conducting extensive research.

The act of allowing oneself to enjoy a particular pleasure, or a thing that is indulged in.
Chocolate is my favorite indulgence.

A chemical element, often used as an antiseptic.
Iodine is essential for thyroid function.

The main structural beam running lengthwise along the bottom of a boat or ship.
The ship's keel was damaged after hitting the reef.

Molten rock found beneath the Earth's surface.
The volcano erupted, spewing hot magma and ash.

a long, soft feather or arrangement of feathers
The knight's helmet was adorned with a colorful plume.

a story or movie that precedes an earlier one
The new movie is a prequel to the popular fantasy series.

action or speech that makes someone annoyed or angry, especially deliberately
He reacted violently to the slightest provocation.

signs collectively
The new signage made it easier to find the correct department.

the state of being sober
After years of struggle, he finally achieved sobriety.

a small, elusive supernatural being; a computer graphic
In folklore, a sprite is often depicted as a mischievous fairy.

place or role that someone or something should have
My colleague will attend the meeting in my stead.

promotional items; confident style
They gave out free swag at the conference, including pens and t-shirts.

a completely different line of thought or action
The speaker went off on a tangent about his personal life.

a substance used to track a process
Scientists used a radioactive tracer to follow the flow of water.

a person or thing that transports
The transporter truck carried heavy machinery to the construction site.

an unused or desolate area of land
The abandoned factory site became a barren wasteland.

a person or group that monitors
The consumer watchdog group exposed the company's unfair practices.

a small, slender carnivorous mammal
The weasel quickly darted across the field.

great enthusiasm and energy; the outer colored part of the peel of a citrus fruit
She approached the challenge with great zest.
